rules.sentence: Clinical criteria (including a thorough history and standard neurologic examination) are 85% accurate in establishing the diagnosis and differentiating Alzheimer's disease from other forms of dementia, such as vascular dementia and Lewy body dementia.
However, deviations from these criteria do not exclude a diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, particularly because patients may have mixed dementia.
